NTA ICAR AIEEA PG, Phd Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the result for the PG/ Ph.D Under NTA ICAR AIEEA Admission Entrance Examination 2026. Applications for the NTA ICAR AIEEA PG, Phd Admissions Online Form 2026 were accepted from 08 May 2026, to 10 June 2026. The written examination was conducted on 04 July 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their NTA ICAR AIEEA PG, Phd Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 May 2026
  • Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 12-14 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 04 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 25 June 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 01 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 August 2026
  • Result : 29 August 2026

Application Fee

  • AIEEA PG Course
  • General : Rs. 1300/-
  • OBC, EWS : Rs. 1255/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 675/-
  • AIEEA JRF / SRF (PHd) Courses
  • General : Rs. 2000/-
  • EWS, OBC : Rs. 1955/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 1025/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.
